schema.layers: 2 oscillateurs superposés par état — tonique + shimmer
schema.actif: 639 Hz pulsé à 1 Hz + shimmer 741 Hz — vivant, énergique
schema.latent: 432 Hz très lent + 396 Hz presque inaudible — repos, respiration
schema.instable: 417 Hz rapide sawtooth + 852 Hz square — chaos perceptible immédiatement
schema.perception: Un utilisateur aveugle sait dans quel état est Luna avant même d'interagir avec le système

content.doc: Ambient State is the continuous background soundscape that reflects Luna's current state without any user action. Two oscillator layers (tonique + shimmer) produce different textures: actif has a warm 639 Hz pulse with gentle shimmer — the system breathes. Latent is barely audible, slow, like deep sleep. Instable is immediately recognizable — sawtooth harmonics at irregular rates, the system is clearly in chaos. A non-visual user opens the application and knows instantly what state Luna is in — no visual required, no reading required. The ambient is always on. It is the first signal.
